title: 第1086章 剑开秘境第1085章 这逆贼早就布好了局
slug: 氪金仙尊首先6元即赠绝色剑仙
content_zh:
仿佛是听到了两位圣人的痛骂。
封印之中，一直闭目打坐的陈怀安，眼珠子动了动。
他抬眸看着晶壁外气急败坏的两尊圣人，嘴角勾起一抹讥讽的笑意。
若他只是以守护剑道来加固九天玄阵，这俩圣人同时出手还真有一丝打破的可能。
但现在这俩老家伙把自己的力量都搭了进去，就像自己把手伸进了瓶子里，握住瓶子里的东西，想再拿出来几乎不可能！
而看他们现在这伤势……
苍云天道打过来了？
甚至于，白剑可能都过来了。
“白剑啊白剑……”
陈怀安呵呵一笑。
知道他被封印的事情，白剑肯定很着急吧？
不过，白剑应该还没出手，以白剑的实力若是出手，这俩圣人怕是已经死了。
还没到时候。
就是不知道李清然怎么样了……
陈怀安心念一动，想从因果中剥离出一丝天机。
可这三重封印虽然把两尊圣人隔绝在外，却也让他难以再窥见因果。
再者，这里是地星不是苍云，更是难上加难。
他唯一能感应到的，就是李清然此刻一切平安。
平安好啊……
平安就够了。

“这孽畜还睁眼看我们！我怀疑他就是故意被我们封印的！”
通天和元始天尊看到陈怀安睁眼瞅着他们更是气得二佛升天。
“可恨我们在这个封印上耗费了那么多力气，却什么成果都拿不到……真是晦气！”
呵呵。
那你们就慢慢晦气去吧。
陈怀安默默听着，也不说话，只是重新闭上眼，继续盘膝调息，神态悠然自得。
仿佛他不是被囚禁的俘虏，而是在自家洞府里闭关修行。
元始与通天看着他这副模样，更是气得胸口发闷。
炼化炼化不动，打又打不着，对方还靠着地脉大阵稳如泰山。
一时间，两人竟有些束手无策。
“现在怎么办？”通天教主深吸一口气，压下怒火，沉声问。
元始天尊脸色阴沉得能滴出水来：“还能怎么办？
content_en:
It was as if I heard the scoldings of the two saints.
Within the seal, Chen Huaian, who had been meditating with his eyes closed, moved his eyes.
He raised his eyes and looked at the two furious saints outside the crystal wall, with a sarcastic smile on his lips.
If he only strengthens the Nine Heavens Mysterious Formation by guarding the way of the sword, there is really a chance that these two saints can break it if they attack at the same time.
But now these two old guys have put their own strength into it, as if they put their hands into the bottle and hold the contents in the bottle. It is almost impossible to take it out again!
And looking at their current injuries...
Cangyun Tiandao is calling?
In fact, Bai Jian may have come over.
"Baijian, Baijian..."
Chen Huaian laughed.
Knowing that he was sealed, Bai Jian must be very anxious, right?
However, Bai Jian probably hasn't made a move yet. With Bai Jian's strength, if he did, these two saints would probably be dead.
It's not that time yet.
I just don’t know what’s going on with Li Qingran…
Chen Huai'an had a thought and wanted to peel off a hint of the secret from cause and effect.
But although these three seals isolated the two saints, it also made it difficult for him to see the cause and effect.
Furthermore, it is even more difficult since this is the earth and stars instead of the sky and clouds.
The only thing he could sense was that Li Qingran was safe at the moment.
Peace is good...
Peace is enough.
"This bastard still opened his eyes to look at us! I suspect he was sealed by us on purpose!"
When Tongtian and Yuanshi Tianzun saw Chen Huaian opening his eyes and looking at them, they were so angry that the two Buddhas ascended to heaven.
"It's a shame that we spent so much effort on this seal but couldn't get any results... What a bad luck!"
Haha.
Then just take your time and get out of luck.
Chen Huaian listened silently and did not speak. He just closed his eyes again and continued to cross his legs and adjust his breathing, with a leisurely and contented expression.
It was as if he was not a prisoner in captivity, but practicing in seclusion in his own cave.
Yuanshi and Tongtian looked at his appearance, and their chests felt tight with anger.
It can't be refined and refined, and it can't be hit again and again. The opponent is still as stable as a mountain by relying on the earth vein formation.
For a moment, the two of them were at a loss what to do.
"What should we do now?" Leader Tongtian took a deep breath, suppressed his anger, and asked in a deep voice.
Yuanshi Tianzun's face was so gloomy that it could drip with water: "What else can we do?
